beats.label: Myth
beats.note: CBN = cannabinol, sold in many sleep gummies

beats.label: Fact
beats.text: Human proof is **thin.** A 2021 review found **too** **little** evidence for sleep claims.

beats.label: Best trial so far
beats.text: **321** poor sleepers, **20** **mg** CBN: overall sleep quality **no** **better** than placebo.
beats.note: Bonn-Miller et al., Exp. Clin. Psychopharmacol.

beats.label: A small plus
beats.text: It did trim night wakings, by about **half** **a** wake-up per night.

beats.label: New mouse study
beats.text: Mice built **tolerance** and showed **withdrawal** signs after just days.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: That was **mice,** not people. Long-term human effects are **unknown.**
beats.note: Ask a doctor before using sleep aids.
